english: “Alice has an identity” is never recorded twice.
If Alice knows Bob, then Alice has an identity.
lean: ∀ (x0 : A) (x1 : A), s.knows x0 x1 > 0 → s.identity x0 > 0

english: If Alice knows Bob, then Bob has an identity.
lean: ∀ (x0 : A) (x1 : A), s.knows x0 x1 > 0 → s.identity x1 > 0

english: If Alice holds a coin issued by Bob, then Alice has an identity.
lean: ∀ (x0 : A) (x1 : A), s.coin x0 x1 > 0 → s.identity x0 > 0

english: If Alice holds a coin issued by Bob, then Bob has an identity.
lean: ∀ (x0 : A) (x1 : A), s.coin x0 x1 > 0 → s.identity x1 > 0

formal: coin(Alice, Bob) and Alice != Bob => knows(Alice, Bob)
english: If Alice holds a coin issued by Bob, and Alice is not Bob, then Alice knows Bob.
lean: ∀ (x0 : A) (x1 : A), s.coin x0 x1 > 0 → x0 ≠ x1 → s.knows x0 x1 > 0
